Maria (runtime): quick note 12: seeing short 40-120ms spikes during lane handoffs for some tenants. not full p99 regressions but annoying jitter.
Devon: same. ties to handoff windows.
Sasha: likely kvcache rebind + kernel swap. moving a hot tenant invalidates residency.
Lee: we should add a handoff_jitter metric: sample latency before/after handoff (1 in N) and emit histogram + trace label.
Maria (runtime): prototype sample config: rate=0.1, windows=[3s,20s], emit traces+hist.
Devon: mitigation ideas: (1) avoid moving hot tenants often, (2) make handoff incremental with "anchor" ops to keep KV warm.
Sasha: anchors = tiny noop ops that preserve residency. need per-GPU anchor token pool to bound cost.
Lee: also add smoothing: delay move if tenant latency slope > threshold (bounded delay).
Maria (runtime): plan: land sampler + handoff_jitter, add simulator flag --simulate-anchors (anchors count as +1 token), run replay, evaluate anchors vs smoothing.
Devon: I'll run replays and post results.
Sasha: will open sampler PR today and add the simulate flag.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary 5% -> 25% scheduled at 15:00 UTC.
Maria (runtime): watch handoff_jitter during canary; alert if median delta > 30ms for any tenant. :eyes:
Devon: ack, thanks.
